sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Snake and Diaz's team competed with [[Dante Vale]]'s team for the [[Titan]], [[Ghostfog]]. The Organization team were defeated after [[Lok Lambert]] recovered Ghostfog and destroyed their boat. {{Source|The Secret of the Flying Dutchman}}

As part of their plan to get hold of Ghostfog, Diaz took [[Cherit]] hostage and left a note for Dante, demanding that he bring Ghostfog to them, ransoming Cherit. The two groups came face to face in Pamplona and Snake received the Amulet. However Cherit escaped and reclaimed Ghostfog and returned him to Lok. A fight then ensued in which Diaz invoked [[Blackbull]]. As a result of the battle, the Organization left empty-handed. {{source|The Bulls of Pamplona}}

full_text:
Snake is a high-ranking Suit of the Organization and Diaz's right hand man. He has an unnerving scar running down one side of his face.

History

Snake and Diaz's team competed with Dante Vale's team for the Titan, Ghostfog. The Organization team were defeated after Lok Lambert recovered Ghostfog and destroyed their boat. [The Secret of the Flying Dutchman]

As part of their plan to get hold of Ghostfog, Diaz took Cherit hostage and left a note for Dante, demanding that he bring Ghostfog to them, ransoming Cherit. The two groups came face to face in Pamplona and Snake received the Amulet. However Cherit escaped and reclaimed Ghostfog and returned him to Lok. A fight then ensued in which Diaz invoked Blackbull. As a result of the battle, the Organization left empty-handed. [The Bulls of Pamplona]

Personality

Like his name suggests, Snake is a callous and sadistic individual who will do whatever he has to to get what he wants. His plan to kidnap Cherit demonstrated his ruthless side.

Abilities

Snake possesses a range of spells.

Spells Utilized

• Boltflare
• Headcage
• Hyperstride
• Magicnet
• Spidertouch
• Raypulse
